svg.title: TOPAK A4 — One orientation, fourteen layers: toward more authority is consensus, toward less is local
svg.desc: Every boundary in the design is asymmetric in the same direction. Crossing toward more authority needs consensus, an issuance or a fresh grant; crossing toward less is local and monotone, needs no quorum, and is attributed. The boundary register found it stated five times in five vocabularies; ToO rev 11 §7.8 states it at fourteen layers. At the pattern level it inverts.
svg.text: TOPAK · A4

text.tspan: One orientation, fourteen layers: toward more authority is consensus, toward less is local

svg.text: Every boundary in the design is asymmetric in the same direction. Crossing toward more authority needs consensus, an issuance or a fresh grant; crossing toward less is local and monotone, needs no quorum, and is attributed. The boundary register found it stated five times in five vocabularies; ToO rev 11 §7.8 states it at fourteen layers. At the pattern level it inverts.
"Every boundary above is asymmetric in the same direction: crossing toward more authority requires consensus, crossing toward less is local and
monotone."
"This is not a boundary: it is the orientation of all of them, and it is stated five times in five vocabularies across the current corpus."

text.tspan: Five vocabularies in 2026.09.13; fourteen layers at ToO rev 11

svg.text: grants versus denials
subtraction from the floor
parse failure is a deny
rung subtraction
findings may deny, never admit

The five are the register's own wording. ToO §7.8 keeps decision, policy and deployment as rows, has no syntax or semantic row of its own, and adds eleven: change, authority, evidence, credential, confinement,
lineage, time, seat, detection, bundle and trusted base.

text.tspan: Monotonicity, layer by layer (ToO rev 11 §7.8, every row)

svg.text: The Statement column is §7.8 verbatim, and so is Source, with confirmation markers added (C1–C4: author-ratified until confirmed). The two direction columns are this diagram's reading of each row, drawn from the sections cited in them (§ alone means ToO rev 11).

text.tspan: ↑ Toward more authority: what it costs
↓ Toward less authority: what it takes

svg.text: Consensus for grants, local for denials
A grant is an admit, consensus-ordered in the Paxos log (ADR-0015)
A denial is not ordered: absence of effect is not an event (ADR-0015)
Established
Bundles only subtract from the floor — by composition, for every bundle
No bundle path at all; the floor itself moves by promotion, and a relaxation adds an anchor issuance (§3.2)
Any bundle, at any age, can only narrow: admit ⟺ floor_permit ∧ ¬bundle_deny
Authority-increasing changes need consensus; decreasing ones need no quorum, are attributed,
and are ordered when they change replicated state
Consensus
No quorum; attributed; ordered only when replicated state changes (revocation, expiry, end of round)
Floor-rollout session; ADR-0033 §4
Degenerate forms lose theorems, never gain capability
A variation with a capability the archetype lacks fails admission: the archetype is incomplete (§8.1)
A degeneracy loses premises and theorems, and carries a declaration record
ADR-0023 C3
Relaxing rules needs the anchor; operating within them does not
An anchor issuance and a promotion (rules-floor changes: both keys in both directions, §7.3)
Operate and subtract under the last resident rules; anchor loss freezes change, never operation
Authority facts survive erasure and break-glass
Removing a forensic class is a floor relaxation (§4.4)
F1–F6 are denials on the erasure envelope: bundles can only narrow erasure further
ADR-0028 C1
Renewal only narrows and keeps the rung; widening needs a fresh grant after the round ends
A fresh grant, once the round has ended: at most one live lease per principal
Renewal narrows the alphabet or shortens the TTL; it keeps bundle, round, role and rung
ADR-0031, A1 C1; C2 for A1
A principal below the declared rung is refused, never granted lower; every host failure the
archetype tolerates subtracts
A grant only on an Attested verdict at the deployment's declared rung
Unattestable refuses; Contested refuses and revokes the principal; no silent downgrade
The projection over-approximates what a round could read, and adding to it can only fail a pair
Independence passes only on upper-bound shares, at the promotion tally and the declaration
Charging a round with more corpus can only fail a pair
ADR-0035 (Proposed)
An interval whose failure subtracts may use a local clock; one whose failure preserves authority
needs trusted time
Break-glass TTL, Persona expiry: trusted time from outside the principal (A6)
Lease expiry, passive e-stop, vote timeout: a local monotonic clock, margin erring early
Only a thinker seat is issued a variant that writes, runs or offers; adding a seat to a cell never
adds authority
Draft, Invoke, Submit, Actuate only for a thinker seat: floor forbid B10
An observer or grant seat reads, emits and votes or denies; adding one adds no variant
Observers combine by any-of, and coupling only refuses: more Observers never lower safety,
and an absent one stalls
None: a finding is deny-only and never an admit precondition (ADR-0007); no Observer quorum
A finding from any member of W(p) takes effect; a dead or slow Observer stops its own Thinker
A bundle loads only under an issued key's signature; a file name is evidence of nothing
Replacing the bundle key is an anchor issuance (ADR-0025 §1 (f))
No verifying signature, no load; an empty key set loads nothing and denies
ADR-0044 C1
A component enters only if its failure can only subtract, or its identity is issued; what can add and
is fixed by nothing is refused
A row that can add enters only as a trust root with an issued identity; adding a row is a relaxation with its
own record
A delegated row's failure only subtracts and needs no proof, key or quorum; removing a row is a tightening

text.tspan: At the pattern level it inverts

svg.text: Every conformant deployment goes into declaration debt (§7.8): what it ran as the archetype is now a degeneracy it must
declare.
Published theorems are voided (§7.8): a property checked against the old archetype stops holding of it.
Nothing bounds how the archetype grows: the archetype-evolution record (versioning, the dominance rule, non-increasing TCB) is
unwritten (§8.2; G7 item 7).

text.tspan: Where the orientation is not yet whole
Break-glass adds authority, with no expiry

svg.text: The one privileged path that adds; register §7.3: a non-expiring grant breaks the monotone story.
R8, a break-glass TTL, is drafted and pending (ADR-0026 A1); vacuous until a mechanism clause ends a grant, and it needs trusted
time (ADR-0032; G7 item 8).
Coupling separates a present Observer from an absent one, not an honest one from a colluding one: every fact it reads is the
Observer's own assertion (§5.4).
R3 also couples break-glass, so an emergency waits on a dead Observer: ratified as written (§5.4).

text.tspan: A row on a Proposed record

svg.text: Lineage rests on ADR-0035, Proposed: the only §7.8 row whose record is not Accepted.
Every other row cites Accepted (genesis) records or an established principle; most of those records carry confirmation markers and
are author-ratified (§0).
